description: The software and firmware names a meter reports, under each profile's firmware section. reads: what each profile reads for its names, in order, as [name, table, address, count]. cases: words as read, in register-address order, and the text each must decode to (value), or the reason it must be refused (refused). An ascii entry is decoded as the serial is: two bytes per register, high byte first, with trailing NULs and then surrounding ASCII whitespace trimmed; what is left must be non-empty (else empty) and printable ASCII, 0x20 to 0x7E (else not_printable). A hex entry is each byte as two uppercase hex digits, high byte first; any word decodes. A read of other than the entry's count of words is wrong_word_count. Names are informational: they never gate a read or label a reading. All names here are invented. Every implementation that reads names must give every value and refuse every refused case.
